reasons.c.integration: The C gRPC arm runs the integration harness through the changed FFI header and consumer-record code.
reasons.c.unit: test_serialization.c gained a header test, the FFI header and consumer-record exports changed, and the generated C header gained a new export that bindings_header checks.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The .NET gRPC arm runs the integration harness through the changed core and FFI.
reasons.dotnet.performance: The performance tests run the changed header and fetch paths.
reasons.dotnet.soak: The soak client produces and consumes through the changed core.
reasons.dotnet.solution: The .NET unit tests (including the native ABI conformance tests over the exports) and integration tests reach the changed FFI header and consumer-record code.
reasons.python.grpc: The Python gRPC arm runs the integration harness through the changed core and FFI.
reasons.python.integration: The Python integration tests produce and consume records with headers through the changed core.
reasons.python.performance: The performance tests run the changed header and fetch paths.
reasons.python.soak: The soak tests run produce and consume loops through the changed header and fetch code.
reasons.python.static: The static tests check the binding against the C export surface, which gained Header__key_bytes.
reasons.python.unit: The Python unit tests pass headers through _confluentkafka.c into the changed FFI header functions.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: The verifiable clients produce and consume through the changed core.
reasons.rust.chaos: The chaos tests run the producer and consumer, whose record and header handling changed.
reasons.rust.consumer: The consumer integration tests read fetched records, whose headers are now parsed on demand as slices of the fetch buffer.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: The package depends on the crate and runs the changed fetch and record-parsing path.
reasons.rust.integration: The integration harness produces and consumes records with headers through the changed core.
reasons.rust.integrity: The integrity tests check record content end to end, headers included, and the change rewrites both the produce and consume paths.
reasons.rust.lib: The change rewrites RecordHeader and RecordHeaders, DefaultRecord parsing, CompletedFetch, FetchCollector, ProducerBatch, utils and the FFI header and consumer-record modules, and adds unit tests to them.
reasons.rust.performance: The performance tests drive the changed produce and fetch header paths.
reasons.rust.producer: The producer integration tests write headers through the changed RecordHeaders and ProducerBatch code.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: The package depends on the crate and produces and consumes through the changed code.
reasons.rust.xtask: The FFI translation lint in xtask (lint_custom/ffi_translation.rs) changed to allow the new C-only Header__key_bytes export.
